description: This file is a shell script that provides a wrapper for the start-stop-daemon utility to manage services. It defines functions for starting, stopping, checking, reloading, and signaling services, as well as environment variables to configure service behavior.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Main function to control service actions such as start, stop, check, and reload based on the passed argument.

methods.name: service_check
methods.description: Checks if the service process is alive.

methods.name: service_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the service process, defaulting to USR1 or configured signal.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the service process, attempting graceful termination within a timeout period before forcing kill.

methods.name: service_reload
methods.description: Reloads the service by sending the reload signal.
